entries.standing: Position 1 in the owner-supplied audited 14 September 2026 revision. Its interlocking perspectives make desire, money, class and political disappointment part of one unusually rich social world. The strongest overall balance of narrative life, psychological ambiguity and lasting Polish importance keeps it first. Renewed German criticism supplies reception evidence, including reservations, rather than a fabricated unanimous verdict.
